tokens.gaps: First insider unlock was the 1-year cliff on 7 Dec 2024 (outside window); all window events are routine monthly tranches. Open question: DefiLlama (per earlier desk research, not re-opened - page blocked this pass) models the post-cliff vesting as continuous linear (~1.04M + 1.57M JTO/week) with no dated events, whereas PANews/Token Unlocks and tokenomics.com treat it as discrete monthly steps on the 7th; the Jito docs do not say which. tokenomics.com lists a final 16.96M tranche on 7 Nov 2026, implying the schedule ends a month earlier than the 7 Dec 2026 the terms suggest - unresolved; does not affect window amounts unless tranche sizes differ from 11.31M. CoinGecko id: Tokenomist slug is 'jito-governance-token' and that is used here; CoinGecko's web page was also seen at /coins/jito - verify the API id before pulling prices. listed 2023-12 from the Dec 2023 TGE (airdrop snapshot 25 Nov 2023 in docs; cliff on 7 Dec 2024).

verify.notes: Jito docs confirm the 3-year vest with a 1-year cliff for 245M + 162.14M. The earliest event (7 Dec 2025 00:00 UTC, 11.31M, PANews/Token Unlocks) checks out, and tokenomics.com lists 7 Oct 2026 as past with a 60.2/39.8 split. Not confirmed: no source prints the Oct 2026 amount, and the docs do not say whether vesting is discrete monthly or continuous (DefiLlama models it as continuous). tokenomics.com also shows an odd 16.96M final tranche on 7 Nov 2026.

dropped.why: The 92.8M figure (52.8M Early Backers + 40M Core Contributors) comes from pre-repurchase docs. Capricorn bought back 5.3% (~52.8M) from early investors in Aug 2026 with undisclosed new vesting; tokenomics.com now shows Early Backers at 10.7% (cliff ~35.3M), CryptoLinks says the Oct treatment is unconfirmed, and published estimates run from ~70.9M to ~149.7M. No post-event source confirms what actually transferred on 23 Oct.

The only evidence is one Phoenix Group infographic, carried by MEXC and BlockchainReporter. tokenomics.com puts every COCA allocation behind a cliff of 24 months or more from the 1 Dec 2024 TGE, with the first post-TGE unlock on 1 Dec 2026. Its 11.3% unlocked figure equals the TGE amount (13.5M treasury + 100M liquidity), which leaves no room for an 18.38M release in Dec 2025.

The only source is a USD-only tracker mention of an Aug 1 event. Tokenomist (kite-2) and CoinLaunch both put KITE releases on the 3rd of the month (next 3 Nov 2026, 153.33M per CoinLaunch) and list nothing for Aug 1. Date, amount and type are unsupported.

No source gives a token amount. Tokenomist places events on a 30-day grid (11 Feb 2026, then 8 Nov 2026, exactly 270 days later), while tokenomics.com schedules investors and insiders monthly on the 14th (12-month cliff plus 24-month linear). This looks like a tracker-modelled step, not a confirmed transfer, and could not be fixed.
